golden_content:
# Outreach Engine Message Style Configuration
# Message formatting, tone, and communication style parameters

# Message Style Framework
message_style:
  default_tone: professional
  formality_level: formal
  personalization_level: high
  industry_adaptation: true

# Tone Profiles
tone_profiles:
  professional:
    formality: high
    language: formal
    greeting_style: formal
    closing_style: professional
    contractions: false
    emojis: false
  
  casual:
    formality: medium
    language: conversational
    greeting_style: friendly
    closing_style: casual
    contractions: limited
    emojis: minimal
  
  enthusiastic:
    formality: medium_low
    language: energetic
    greeting_style: warm
    closing_style: enthusiastic
    contractions: allowed
    emojis: limited

# Message Structure Templates
structure_templates:
  initial_contact:
    opening: personal_greeting
    body: introduction + value_proposition + call_to_action
    closing: professional_signature
    max_len
